title: Charter school authorizer and opening year
source: New York State Education Department, NYS Charter School Directory (Excel, as of Sept. 2, 2025) and NYSED charter school pages; DBN crosswalk from NYC DOE LCGMS and NYC Open Data 2019-20 School Locations

authorizer.label: Charter authorizer
authorizer.definition: The body that granted and oversees the school's charter. Readable label for the directory's Authorizer code: SUNY = SUNY Charter Schools Institute (SUNY trustees), Regents = NYS Board of Regents (through NYSED's Charter School Office), NYCDOE = NYC Department of Education (Chancellor).
authorizer.source_field: Authorizer (Sheet1, NYS Charter School Directory xlsx)

authorizer_code.label: Authorizer (as listed)
authorizer_code.definition: Authorizer exactly as written in NYSED's Excel directory: SUNY, Regents or NYCDOE.
authorizer_code.source_field: Authorizer (Sheet1, NYS Charter School Directory xlsx)

year_opened.label: Year opened
year_opened.definition: Year the school opened, per NYSED. Values of 2026 were listed on NYSED's web page as 'Opening in 2026' (approved but not yet operating when the directory was compiled).
year_opened.source_field: Year Opened (Sheet1, NYS Charter School Directory xlsx)

authorizer_url.label: Authorizer's page for this school
authorizer_url.definition: SUNY and NYC DOE schools: the 'School Information Maintained by ...' link on the school's NYSED page (SUNY school profile or schools.nyc.gov school page). Regents schools: the NYSED school page itself, since NYSED's Charter School Office oversees schools for the Board of Regents. Null when NYSED gives no school-specific link.
authorizer_url.source_field: link text 'School Information Maintained by ...' on https://www.nysed.gov/charter-schools/<school> pages

nysed_url.label: NYSED charter page
nysed_url.definition: The school's page in NYSED's Charter Schools Directory (annual reports, financial statements, renewal reports, links to state data).

sed_code.label: NYSED BEDS code
sed_code.definition: NYSED's 12-digit institution code for the school, used to match it to a DOE DBN.
sed_code.source_field: SED Code (Sheet1, NYS Charter School Directory xlsx)

nysed_name.label: Name in NYSED directory
nysed_name.definition: School name as NYSED lists it (can differ from the DOE name).
nysed_name.source_field: Charter School Name (Sheet1, NYS Charter School Directory xlsx)

crosswalk.label: DBN match method
crosswalk.definition: How the NYSED code was matched to the DBN: lcgms_beds, locations_2019_20_beds, lcgms_charter_number, locations_2019_20_charter_number or manual. See notes.

notes: Charter term / renewal end date: NOT included. Neither NYSED's Excel directory nor its web directory gives a term or expiration date. SUNY's school pages show grades and enrollment 'at End of Charter Term' but not the date; NYSED's pages for Regents schools list authorized grades by school year but don't label the end of the term. No bulk source was found.

The Excel file is the current one on NYSED's directory page as of 2026-10-07. NYSED labels it the 2025-2026 directory, as of Sept. 2, 2025; it has not been updated for 2026-27, so schools that opened in fall 2026 may be listed with year 2026 and some may be missing.
Crosswalk counts: lcgms_beds = 268, lcgms_charter_number = 15, locations_2019_20_beds = 6, locations_2019_20_charter_number = 1, manual = 1. 291 of 299 NYSED NYC rows matched.

Matches by rules 2-4 where the NYSED and DOE names differ beyond punctuation: 84X487: NYSED 'Girls Preparatory Charter School of the Bronx' / DOE 'Bronx Charter School for Excellence 6' (lcgms_charter_number); 84X630: NYSED 'Girls Preparatory Charter School of the Bronx II' / DOE 'Bronx Charter School for Excellence 8' (lcgms_charter_number). The two Girls Preparatory Bronx schools now run under Bronx Charter School for Excellence names. SUNY's authorizer page for 'Girls Preparatory Charter School of the Bronx' (girls-prep-charter-school-bronx) is now titled 'Bronx Charter School for Excellence 6', which matches DOE's 84X487.

Manual matches: 342700861100 -> 84Q422: NYSED 'Success Academy Charter School-NYC 14' = LCGMS 84Q422 'Success Academy Charter School - NYC 14'. LCGMS's BEDS field for 84Q422 holds the malformed '38400010422', and the charter-number suffix 861100 is shared with another NYSED NYC row (South Bronx Community Charter High School), so rules 1-3 can't match it.

Unmatched NYSED NYC rows (no DBN found in LCGMS or 2019-20 School Locations; mostly schools opening in 2025 or 2026): Achievement First Charter School 11 (SED 331600861085, opened 2025, SUNY); Explore Enrich Charter School (SED 331700861047, opened 2025, SUNY); Lamad Averne Academy Charter School (SED 320700861202, opened 2025, SUNY); Next Generation Charter School (SED 321200861203, opened 2026, SUNY); South Bronx Classical Charter School VI (SED 321100861138, opened 2025, Regents); Success Academy Charter School – NYC 15 (SED 331700861038, opened 2025, SUNY); Success Academy Charter School - NYC 18 (SED 321000861206, opened 2026, SUNY); Uncommon New York City Charter School #1 (SED 331300861119, opened 2025, SUNY).
DOE LCGMS charter codes with no NYSED NYC directory match: 84OBIG Intellectus Preparatory Charter School; 84X554 Choice Charter School.

authorizer_url: on 2026-10-07, 206 of the 207 distinct 'School Information Maintained by' links resolved (HTTP 200). One returned 404 and is left null: https://www.newyorkcharters.org/math-engineering-and-science-academy-charter-high-school-2-2/. The generic SUNY link (newyorkcharters.org/charter-schools/) is also left null.

Authorizer conflicts between NYSED's Excel file and its school pages: 84X461 Nuasin Next Generation Charter School: Excel authorizer SUNY, but its NYSED page says the school information is maintained by the NYC-DoE (https://www.schools.nyc.gov/schools/X461); authorizer kept from the Excel file, authorizer_url left null.
Cross-check: for 34 DOE-authorized schools, NYSED's link to schools.nyc.gov/schools/<location code> agrees with the crosswalk DBN ('84' + location code) in every case.
Every school in this file is a charter. The atlas's charter records come from DOE lists, so a few DOE charter DBNs may not appear here.
